mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals a sharp weakening in labor market conditions, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment exceeding 0.5pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals a sharp weakening in demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling consumption exceeding 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 3-month increase in the unemployment rate and a 3-month decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a sharp weakening in labor market conditions, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment and falling payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a sharp weakening in demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling consumption and falling housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).
